hook.en: Finding a tender point, then holding the body in the position of most comfort for about 90 seconds to settle it.
hook.ur: Strain Counterstrain ya positional release ek indirect approach hai: sensitive area ko aisi position mein le jaya jata hai jahan patient ko zyada comfort ho, phir dheere se neutral position mein wapas laya jata hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll know what Strain Counterstrain / Positional Release is, when it's safe and useful, how to apply it step by step — and how to prove it worked. (3 checks along the way.)
goal.ur: End tak aap jaan jayenge ke Strain Counterstrain / Positional Release kya hai, kab safe aur faida-mand hai, qadam ba qadam kaise apply hoti hai — aur kaise prove karein ke kaam kiya. (Raste mein 3 checks.)

text.en: Strain-Counterstrain (also called positional release) uses a tender point on the body as a guide. You gently place the body so the tender point becomes much less sore, hold for about 90 seconds, then return slowly.
text.ur: Painful ya tender region ko maximal comfort wali position mein rakh kar kuch dair hold kiya jata hai aur phir ahista neutral position mein wapas laya jata hai.

simpler.en: Finding a tender point, then holding the body in the position of most comfort for about 90 seconds to settle it.
simpler.ur: Strain Counterstrain ya positional release ek indirect approach hai: sensitive area ko aisi position mein le jaya jata hai jahan patient ko zyada comfort ho, phir dheere se neutral position mein wapas laya jata hai.

text.en: Like loosening a taut guitar string by moving the tuning peg slightly closer: instead of stretching the sore spot, you slacken it.
text.ur: Jaise tani hui guitar string ko tuning peg thora qareeb ghuma kar dheela karna: dard wali jagah ko kheenchne ke bajaye aap usay dheela (slack) karte hain.

text.en:
Three ideas carry this whole technique:
**1.** Move toward comfort, not into stretch.
**2.** Use the patient's tenderness rating as the guide: reduce it by at least about 70 percent.
**3.** Return to neutral slowly and recheck the tender point.
text.ur: Comfortable positioning, contextual effects aur sensory input mein tabdeeli se pain ya protective muscle activity kam ho sakti hai. Tender-point model jagah identify karne mein madad de sakta hai, lekin yeh kisi khaas structural lesion ka saboot nahi.

question.ur: Pehle vocabulary — clinicians yeh lafz bohat use karte hain. **Tender point** ka matlab kya hai?

text.en:
So when does **Strain Counterstrain / Positional Release** make sense?
• Acute or irritable muscle or joint tenderness where stretching hurts.
• Patients who cannot tolerate firm treatment.
• As a gentle option before movement-based approaches.
text.ur: Zyada irritable myofascial pain; protective muscle guarding; tender-point dominant presentations.

text.en:
And just as important — when you should NOT use it, or should stop:
• Unstable fracture or serious joint or spine instability.
• Positioning causes pain, dizziness or neurological symptoms.
• Cannot achieve a comfortable position.
text.ur:
Aise patients jo positioning bardasht na kar saken, severe osteoporosis, ya recent surgery.
Aisi position jo breathing ya circulation ko mutasir kare, surgical precautions ki khilaf-warzi kare, ya unstable injury mein risk barhaye.

title.en: How to do it — 6 steps, each with its reason
title.ur: Kaise karein — 6 qadam, har ek ki wajah ke saath

steps.title: Find the tender point
steps.detail: Press gently and ask for a 0-10 rating. Say 10 is the baseline.

steps.title: Maintain light pressure
steps.detail: Keep a finger on the point so you can monitor.

steps.title: Move toward ease
steps.detail: Slowly bend, rotate or side-bend the body part toward shortening the tissue until the rating falls, aiming for 3/10 or lower.

steps.title: Fine-tune
steps.detail: Make tiny adjustments to reach the lowest rating.

steps.title: Hold
steps.detail: Hold about 90 seconds while the patient breathes comfortably.

steps.title: Return slowly and recheck
steps.detail: Slowly return to neutral and press the point again.

beats.ur:
1. Reproducible tender point identify karke baseline tenderness note karein.
2. Patient ko passive taur par comfort ki taraf position karein, jab tak tenderness wazeh taur par kam na ho.
3. Position ko pain provoke kiye baghair maintain karein.
4. Patient se assist karwaye baghair ahista neutral par wapas laayein.
5. Tenderness aur functional movement dobara check karein.

text.en: How much? Typical teaching range: about 90 seconds per tender point, usually a few points per session, with gentle pressure only. Stop if symptoms increase.
text.ur: Traditional teaching mein takreeban 90 seconds ka hold bataya jata hai, lekin duration response ke mutabiq individualize ho sakti hai. Be-wajah bohat se tender points treat karne se bachein.

beats.patient: Grace, 56, tender spot at the front of her neck after a prolonged posture, painful on extending the head.
beats.assessment: Tender point rated 8/10. No red flags.
beats.treatment: You place her head in slight flexion and side-bend until the point is 2/10. Hold 90 seconds, slowly return.
beats.reassess: The point is now 3/10 and extension is less painful. You add posture advice and gentle movement.
beats.ur:
Ek misal se poora clinical flow dekhein:
Farz karein shoulder ke qareeb ek position mein tenderness barhti hai aur doosri comfortable position mein kam hoti hai. Clinician comfort wali position ko test karke baad mein movement dobara assess karta hai. Yeh illustrative example hai, diagnosis ka saboot nahi.

text.en:
The mistakes I see most often:
• Using heavy pressure on the point.
• Moving into stretch instead of toward comfort.
• Returning too quickly.
text.ur: Tender point par hard pressure dena, painful position mein rakhna aur tenderness kam hone ko complete recovery samajhna aam ghaltiyan hain. Position se pehle aur baad tenderness compare karein, phir original movement ya functional task dobara check karein. Symptoms unchanged ya worse hon to plan reconsider karein.

text.en: Evidence is limited to small studies. Reported benefit may reflect relaxation, pain modulation and positive expectations. The traditional muscle-spindle explanation is not proven.
text.ur: Strain-counterstrain ko har pain ka proven solution ya muscle ko permanently reset karne wali technique na kahein. Response vary karta hai aur evidence condition ke hisaab se mukhtalif ho sakta hai. Isay assessment aur broader rehabilitation ka ek mumkin hissa samjhayen.

text.en: One line to carry into the clinic: **Find the sore point, move toward ease, hold, return slowly.**
text.ur: Har tender point dhoondhna maqsad nahi; technique tabhi jari rakhein jab function ya symptoms mein useful tabdeeli ho.
